name: VoidSMP
description:
WELCOME TO VOIDMC SURVIVAL! 

Build your empire, explore the world, make friends, become rich, or start a war — the choice is yours!

 WHAT VOIDMC OFFERS:

 Player Shops — Create your own shop and build your fortune.

 Player Warps — Set up your own warp and let others visit your builds.

 Auction House — Buy, sell, and trade items with players across the server.

 Coin Flips — Feeling lucky? Challenge other players and put your coins on the line!

 Crates — Open crates and discover awesome rewards, rare items, and valuable loot.

 Proximity Voice Chat — Talk to players around you with Proximity Voice Chat for the ultimate survival experience!

 BUILD. TRADE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE.

Whether you're a builder, grinder, trader, PvP player, or just looking for a great community, VoidMC has something for everyone.

 Your adventure starts now. Enter the VOID.
